news.title: 科大讯飞开启全场景主动式AI座舱新时代
news.title_en: iFlytek Ushers in a New Era of All-Scenario Proactive AI Cockpit
news.summary: 科大讯飞发布了基于星火大模型的新一代多模态智能座舱，实现了覆盖高频全场景的自然语言控车，用户无需记忆指令，仅用日常语言即可控制车辆，例如说“我有点热”系统便会自动调节空调。从用户研究视角看，该功能将交互从“命令驱动”转向“意图驱动”，极大降低了认知负荷，解决了用户因记忆复杂指令而产生的挫败感，创造了更自然、无感的车内交互场景。商业上，这种主动式、场景化的AI座舱能显著提升用户对智能系统的依赖度和满意度，为后续的软件订阅服务和生态增值（如个性化场景包）奠定基础，形成差异化竞争壁垒。
news.summary_en: iFlytek released a new-generation multimodal intelligent cockpit based on the Spark large model, enabling natural language vehicle control across high-frequency scenarios. Users can control the vehicle using everyday language without memorizing commands; for example, saying 'I feel hot' will automatically adjust the air conditioning. From a user research perspective, this feature shifts interaction from 'command-driven' to 'intent-driven,' significantly reducing cognitive load, solving user frustration from memorizing complex commands, and creating a more natural, seamless in-car interaction scenario. Commercially, such a proactive, scenario-based AI cockpit can significantly enhance user reliance and satisfaction with the intelligent system, laying the foundation for subsequent software subscription services and ecosystem value-added features (e.g., personalized scenario packs), forming a differentiated competitive barrier.

news.title: 智能座舱的终局是什么？面壁智能给出了自己的答案
news.title_en: What is the Endgame of Smart Cockpits? Mianbi Intelligence Gives Its Answer
news.summary: 面壁智能在吉利银河M9上展示了其座舱方案，已实现部分场景下的主动智能，如能见度差时自动开启雾灯、过收费站自动降窗、车内人员检测并分别响应，这些动作均由车辆自主完成而非用户指令触发。从用户研究视角看，该方案解决了传统座舱“被动响应”的痛点，通过多模态感知（视觉、环境）预判用户需求，创造了“无感服务”体验，减少了用户操作步骤，尤其提升了驾驶安全性和便利性。商业上，这种主动智能是座舱从“工具”向“管家”演进的关键，能有效提升用户粘性，并通过场景化服务（如自动降窗与支付系统联动）开辟新的增值服务收入，成为行业竞争的新高地。
news.summary_en: Mianbi Intelligence demonstrated its cockpit solution on the Geely Galaxy M9, achieving proactive intelligence in certain scenarios, such as automatically turning on fog lights in poor visibility, lowering windows at toll booths, and detecting and responding to individual occupants, all triggered autonomously by the vehicle rather than user commands. From a user research perspective, this solution addresses the pain point of traditional 'passive response' cockpits by anticipating user needs through multimodal perception (vision, environment), creating a 'frictionless service' experience that reduces user steps, especially enhancing driving safety and convenience. Commercially, this proactive intelligence is key to evolving the cockpit from a 'tool' to a 'butler,' effectively boosting user stickiness and opening new value-added service revenue streams through scenario-based services (e.g., linking automatic window lowering with payment systems), becoming a new competitive frontier.

news.title: 比亚迪智能座舱升级：语音指令直接购买高铁票
news.title_en: BYD Smart Cockpit Upgrade: Voice Commands to Directly Purchase High-Speed Rail Tickets
news.summary: 比亚迪宣布其智能座舱系统升级后，用户可通过语音指令直接完成高铁票购买，例如说出“我想去杭州东站坐高铁”，系统将自动调取通义大模型的实时数据接口，提供车次查询、余票确认及购票入口，全程仅需语音交互。从用户研究视角看，该功能将座舱从单纯的“出行工具”延伸为“生活服务入口”，解决了用户在出行规划中需切换多个APP的痛点，创造了“一站式”的出行前服务场景，极大提升了便利性。商业上，这种深度整合第三方生活服务的模式，不仅增强了用户对车机系统的依赖，还为车企开辟了基于交易分成的生态收益，同时通过高频生活服务绑定用户，提升品牌忠诚度。
news.summary_en: BYD announced that after its smart cockpit system upgrade, users can complete high-speed rail ticket purchases via voice commands. For example, saying 'I want to go to Hangzhou East Station by high-speed rail' will automatically invoke the Tongyi large model's real-time data interface, providing train schedule queries, ticket availability confirmation, and purchase entry, all through voice interaction. From a user research perspective, this feature extends the cockpit from a mere 'transportation tool' to a 'life service portal,' solving the pain point of needing to switch between multiple apps for travel planning and creating a 'one-stop' pre-travel service scenario, greatly enhancing convenience. Commercially, this deep integration of third-party life services not only increases user reliance on the in-vehicle system but also opens up ecosystem revenue streams based on transaction commissions for automakers, while binding users through high-frequency life services to boost brand loyalty.

news.title: 蔚来萤火虫座舱交互：打破同质化的大胆尝试
news.title_en: NIO Firefly Cockpit Interaction: A Bold Attempt to Break Homogenization
news.summary: 蔚来旗下品牌萤火虫的座舱交互系统被专业实验室通过模拟驾驶平台和眼动仪进行深度评测，旨在评估其在15万元价位如何实现个性化和独特的交互体验。从用户研究视角看，该评测聚焦于交互的易用性和创新性，通过客观数据（如眼动轨迹、操作时间）量化用户体验，旨在解决当前座舱交互同质化严重的问题，为细分市场用户创造差异化的情感价值。商业上，萤火虫作为蔚来向下探市场的品牌，其独特的交互设计是吸引年轻用户和价格敏感用户的关键，有助于在竞争激烈的入门级市场建立品牌辨识度，并通过独特的交互体验提升用户口碑和复购率。
news.summary_en: The cockpit interaction system of NIO's sub-brand Firefly was deeply evaluated by a professional lab using a simulated driving platform and eye tracker, aiming to assess how it achieves personalization and unique interaction at the 150,000 RMB price point. From a user research perspective, the evaluation focuses on usability and innovation, quantifying user experience through objective data (e.g., eye movement trajectories, operation time), aiming to solve the severe homogenization problem in current cockpit interactions and create differentiated emotional value for niche market users. Commercially, as NIO's brand targeting the lower-end market, Firefly's unique interaction design is key to attracting young and price-sensitive users, helping to establish brand recognition in the competitive entry-level market and enhancing user word-of-mouth and repurchase rates through a distinctive interaction experience.

news.title: 理想任务大师：用户自定义自动化场景，解放双手
news.title_en: Li Auto Task Master: User-Defined Automation Scenarios, Hands-Free
news.summary: 理想汽车的任务大师功能允许用户自定义自动化场景，例如设置“当主驾车门打开且副驾或后排有人坐时，自动开启离车不下电模式”，通过简单的触发条件和执行动作组合，实现个性化智能体验。从用户研究视角看，该功能将座舱智能的“定义权”交给用户，解决了用户对固定场景模式“不够用”或“不适用”的痛点，创造了高度可定制的“我的座舱”体验，极大提升了用户参与感和满意度。商业上，任务大师通过用户共创生态（如分享码）增强了社区活跃度和用户粘性，同时为车企提供了用户行为数据的宝贵来源，有助于优化默认场景设计，并可能在未来推出高级自动化模板作为付费内容，开辟新的收入模式。
news.summary_en: Li Auto's Task Master feature allows users to customize automation scenarios, such as setting 'when the driver's door opens and the front passenger or rear seats are occupied, automatically enable the 'stay powered on when leaving' mode,' achieving personalized intelligent experiences through simple trigger conditions and action combinations. From a user research perspective, this feature hands over the 'definition power' of cockpit intelligence to users, solving the pain point of fixed scenario modes being 'insufficient' or 'inapplicable,' creating a highly customizable 'my cockpit' experience that greatly enhances user engagement and satisfaction. Commercially, Task Master boosts community activity and user stickiness through a user co-creation ecosystem (e.g., sharing codes), while providing automakers with a valuable source of user behavior data, helping to optimize default scenario designs and potentially introducing premium automation templates as paid content in the future, opening new revenue streams.
